title: arabis holboellii var. retrofracta
intro: Arabis holboellii var. retrofracta, commonly known as Rockcress, is a perennial plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health issues. The Rockcress plant is valued for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates and isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress.
